newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close up as interest rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close up as interest rates fall.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed up after taking heart at a larger-than-expected six percentage point fall in interest rates at today's auction of Central Bank TEMs, brokers said.
"There was an especially important late move into Electricidad de Caracas -- basically due to the drop in TEM yields," said Investico broker Jose Antonio Oliveros.
Bellwether stock Electricidad finished 9.70 bolivars ahead at 400.00, helping the bolsa's 19-share .IBC index to firm 0.94 percent to end the day at 4,631.66 points.

Among traded issues 15 rose, 13 fell and four closed flat as nearly seven million shares traded to a total value of 1.5 billion bolivars ($3.2 million), according to preliminary figures from the stock exchange.
Yields on six-month TEMs fell over six percentage points at the 20 billion bolivar auction to 27.93 percent from last week's 34.12 percent level.
